method: Population: the 18 graded rows of coverage-d34.json (all drawn: fewer than 50). Draw: scripts/measure-audit-sample.mjs, seed d11:ipcc-pathways:d34. Per row: scenario values against the edition (and where each value was first printed), set completeness, observed series and definition, observed value re-read from the NOAA file and the GCB 2025 workbook, year, verdict. Findings are fixed for every row in scripts/scenario-coverage-d34.mjs (values first printed after the edition are excluded; a group of one scenario is not a set range); coverage-d34.json counts fixed and residual findings as data/graded/audit does (#53).
